message.email_body: Manually straightening UVs again and again can be very time-consuming for your 3D modeling audience. Your video Straighten UVs in ONE CLICK | Maya caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth, and we are proposing an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This gives your audience practical ideas while you work with an education consulting team. Would a short call this month suit you?
